key.name: filter-junk
key.description: Whether SamRewritten should filter junk items.

key.name: filter-only-idling
key.description: Whether the app list should show only the apps that are currently being idled.

key.name: filter-hide-fully-unlocked
key.description: Whether to hide apps whose achievements are all unlocked.

key.name: filter-hide-never-launched
key.description: Whether to hide apps that have never been played.

key.name: filter-hide-no-unlocked
key.summary: Hide Apps With No Unlocked Achievement
key.description: Whether to hide apps where no achievement has been unlocked yet.

key.name: filter-hide-without-achievements
key.description: Whether to hide apps that expose no achievements at all.

key.name: sidebar-visible
key.description: Whether the app list sidebar (profile, filters and sort) is shown.

key.name: app-theme
key.description: The preferred color scheme for the application. Valid values are 'system', 'light', and 'dark'.

key.name: app-language
key.description: Preferred UI language as a locale code (e.g. 'fr'). An empty value follows the system locale.

key.name: achievement-language
key.description: Steam language code (e.g. 'french') used to read achievement and stat names from the game's schema. An empty value uses the game's own language.

key.name: app-sort
key.description: How the app list is sorted. Valid values are 'app_id', 'alphabetical', 'last_played', 'playtime', 'completion' (highest completion percentage first), and 'remaining' (fewest achievements left to unlock first).

key.name: disable-animations
key.description: Whether to disable card hover animations in the app list.

key.name: unlock-mode
key.description: How the achievement view commits toggles. Valid values are 'autocommit' (each switch commits immediately), 'deferred' (toggles build an ordered queue that the user fires later), and 'copytiming' (replay a friend's unlock cadence).

key.name: copy-timing-max-gap-minutes
key.description: In copy-timing mode, the largest gap kept between two consecutive unlocks. Real gaps longer than this (e.g. between play sessions on different days) are compressed to this value.

key.name: copy-timing-first-delay-minutes
key.description: In copy-timing mode, how long to wait before the first achievement is unlocked.

key.name: copy-timing-friend
key.description: Last persona name or SteamID64 used as the source in copy-timing mode.

key.name: auto-fill-unit
key.description: Which unit the Auto-fill target is expressed in. Valid values are 'count' (number of achievements) and 'percent' (target completion percentage).

key.name: auto-fill-count
key.description: Last value used for the count-based auto-fill target.

key.name: auto-fill-percent
key.description: Last value used for the percent-based auto-fill target (0 to 100).

key.name: unlock-duration-minutes
key.description: Total time window over which deferred unlocks are spread.

key.name: unlock-spacing
key.description: How deferred unlocks are spread over the duration. Valid values are 'even' (equally spaced) and 'random' (first and last pinned to even positions, middle jittered).

key.name: action-journal-enabled
key.description: Whether every change SamRewritten makes is recorded to a local history file, so it can be reviewed and undone. Turning this off stops recording; anything already recorded is kept.
